title: Arrange Overview
hint: Drag a card or a section, or use its arrows, to move it. Choose a half or a full row for a card, and switch one off to hide it.
reset_done: Overview is back as it was.
undo_stale: Not undone: Overview was changed since.
always_shown: Always shown: it holds what needs you
sections_local: Cards follow on all your devices; the sections' order is saved in this browser only, as this hub can't keep it yet.
